rice_ball.name: Rice Ball
rice_ball.desc: Still a little warm. Someone made it with care.

apple.name: Night Apple
apple.desc: It grows only in the dark part of the forest.

bread.name: Warm Bread
bread.desc: Soft. It smells like a kitchen you remember.

dinner.name: Someone's Dinner
dinner.desc: From the tray by your door. "Please eat something."

moon_drop.name: Moon Drop
moon_drop.desc: A drop of moonlight. It fills your hands again.

candle.name: Candle Stub
candle.desc: Half burnt. Light, a little at a time.

lethe_water.name: Lethe Water
lethe_water.desc: It heals everything. It also takes something.

heart_thread.name: Heart Thread
heart_thread.desc: Red thread, to mend a heart. Your heart holds more.

moon_pearl.name: Moon Pearl
moon_pearl.desc: Round and cold. Your light lasts longer.

sharp_shard.name: Sharp Shard
sharp_shard.desc: Another piece of the mirror. The blade grows.

letter_page.name: Letter Page
letter_page.desc: "I'm sorry" again. But this time it goes on.

leaf.name: Green Leaf
leaf.desc: Alive. Bring it to the dry tree.

figure.name: Magical Girl Figure
figure.desc: From the shelf in your room. How did it get here?

old_key.name: Old Key
old_key.desc: Heavy and cold. It opens something under the roots.

toy_wand.name: Toy Wand
toy_wand.desc: From the magical girl on the poster. It still lights up.

hoodie.name: Oversized Hoodie
hoodie.desc: Not yours. It still smells like someone.

bracelet.name: Hospital Bracelet
bracelet.desc: Your name is printed on it. Spelled wrong.

moth_charm.name: Moth Charm
moth_charm.desc: Moths fly to the light. So do you, now.

little_bell.name: Little Bell
little_bell.desc: It rings when nobody touches it.

violet_ribbon.name: Violet Ribbon
violet_ribbon.desc: The same violet as your dress.
